concerns.text: SC‑005 (runtime ≤ 30 min) is not linked to any task. No task measures or asserts the end‑to‑end execution time of the full pipeline, so the performance success criterion cannot be verified.

The three contract schemas (topology, vdos, correlation) have no associated task that explicitly validates generated artefacts against them. Contract‑validation tests exist in the repository but are not listed as tasks, leaving contract coverage uncovered.

Constitution Principle I requires random seeds to be pinned, yet no task creates, documents, or verifies a seed‑initialisation artifact (e.g., a config file or seed‑setup script). This gap risks violating reproducibility.
